items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Because we wanted to stay up and get away from Astie (inaudible).

ctx.x: And so, like, all the musicians would hang out with me like Tony Pastor and all these different guys would come over from Artie Shaw's band.
That's where we would hang out together, you know, at nighttime. Because we wanted to stay up and get away from Astie (inaudible).
They didn't want nobody to find out what they were doing, so they come over to Mother's Lunch with me, go up on the top floor, have chicken, talk and play records, you know, and things like that.
